NIXOID NEXT shows the time on two genuine IN-16 nixie tubes. They were made in the USSR half a century ago and still burn with the same warm orange neon light. Each watch is hand-built in a CNC-milled aluminium case, and the latest firmware brings new features. What's new in Update 2 ● 6 digit animations — None · Slot Machine · Depth · Fade · Ignition · Random Ignition ● 6 seconds styles — None · Plain · Pulse · Crossfade · Neon Strike · Depth ● Tube brightness — 5 levels, set from the menu ● Backlight — 6 levels, with separate HRS / MIN indicator LEDs ● Anti-poisoning warm-up — All cathodes light briefly before each view to keep the tubes healthy for years ● Flashlight mode — Hold the button and the backlight stays on ● Battery level in % — Shown right on the tubes when you hold the button ● 12 / 24 h format — Switch in one menu step ● Precision rate trim — Fine-tune the watch's accuracy from the menu ● Settings memory — All your settings are kept, even with no power ● Tilt gesture (optional) — Check the time with a turn of the wrist, no button needed View the Update 2 manual → Specifications Tubes 2 × IN-16 nixie (new old stock), cold cathode Tube lifetime 10,000+ hours of continuous operation Case CNC-milled aluminium 2026 T4, two-piece Glass Sapphire crystal, scratch resistant Protection Dust and splash resistant Controls One knurled button + optional tilt sensor Timekeeping M41T81 real-time clock, adjustable rate trim Display Hours, then minutes · date on a double press Battery Li-Po 220 mAh · 2000+ time views per charge Charging USB, about 60 min · LED turns off when full Strap 24 mm width / 24 mm lug, pogo-pin connection In the box ● NIXOID NEXT nixie wrist watch ● Strap ● USB charging cable ● Magnet for power on/off ● Printed manual in English ● NIXOID gift box Built for everyday wear The watch is light and compact, with a solid two-piece metal case and sapphire glass, so it can be worn all day. Everything runs from a single button: press once for the time, twice for the date, hold for the battery level and flashlight. When the battery runs low, the watch warns you and goes to sleep, and the clock keeps running. A piece of electronics history on your wrist, handmade and up to date. Shipping Free worldwide shipping on all orders. Delivery takes 10–25 business days after your order is processed, depending on your location. Warranty 1-year manufacturer warranty from the date of purchase. Nixie tubes are covered by a lifetime warranty. If anything goes wrong, contact us at info@nixoid.store and we will arrange a replacement as quickly as possible. Tax and customs Any taxes and customs duties are the responsibility of the buyer, including all charges related to shipping and import. Return policy We do not accept returns for items that match the listing description. Returns are accepted only for unused, non-customised and non-personalised items.
